title: theodorea neopulchella
intro: Theodorea neopulchella, commonly known as Brazilian cherry or mururé, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. Theodorea neopulchella has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions like arthritis and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Theodorea neopulchella include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
